error_codes.adduct_name_mismatch: an adduct name that disagrees with multiplier, add and remove
error_codes.adduct_polarity: an adduct whose charge contradicts its name or the rule's ion mode
error_codes.bad_type: a value of the wrong JSON type (floats must be written with a decimal point)
error_codes.bad_value: a value outside its enum, pattern, length or range
error_codes.claim_single_ion: with every non-claim unit present, no or one claim unit satisfies the logic (pass 2)
error_codes.claim_term_role: a claim term that is repeated or is not a support term
error_codes.claim_terms_too_few: a measured rule claiming on fewer than two terms (design 3.5)
error_codes.complementary_multi_member: a complementary term with more than one member in some hypothesis
error_codes.complementary_pair: a complementary pair of one term, of one kind, of non-support terms, or repeated
error_codes.control_char: a string with a code point below 0x20 or 0x7F
error_codes.duplicate_id: a table id (adduct name or alias, unit, motif, scaffold, nesting pair) defined twice
error_codes.duplicate_key: a key occurs twice in one object
error_codes.file_name_mismatch: rule_id or list_id differs from the file stem
error_codes.float_precision: a float with more than 15 significant digits
error_codes.formula_dependent_key: a key that reads a formula (directive: MS2 rules never consult a formula)
error_codes.formula_not_hill: a formula not in strict Hill order, or an element repeated
error_codes.history_format: a malformed or repeated ruleset-history.tsv row
error_codes.kind_field_choice: not exactly one of the alternative fields (term kind source, unit class/name)
error_codes.logic_depth: logic deeper than 16 or larger than 256 nodes
error_codes.logic_node: a logic node that is not exactly one of all, any, not, k_of, term
error_codes.mass_precision: an element or electron mass with more than 12 fraction digits
error_codes.mass_range: a mass that is not positive or not below 2^53 pDa
error_codes.missing_required_unit: units.json lacks Hex, dHex, Pen or HexA
error_codes.missing_source: an as_published (or source_defined) row with no source
error_codes.mode_mismatch: the rule_id mode differs from preconditions.ion_mode
error_codes.negative_count: a negative count (unit range, ion or precursor composition)
error_codes.nesting_cycle: motif nesting with a cycle or a self-loop
error_codes.nesting_depth: arrays and objects nested deeper than 128
error_codes.non_ascii: a string with a code point above 0x7F
error_codes.number_range: an integer above 2^53-1 or a float outside 0 and [1e-4, 1e15)
error_codes.origin_inconsistent: parameters_origin differs from the derived maximum
error_codes.review_stale: review.rule_semantic_sha256 differs from the recomputed one
error_codes.role_placement: a role outside its place in the logic (design 3.6 item 3)
error_codes.ruleset_sha_mismatch: the history row for rule_set_version names another sha256
error_codes.series_empty: no composition satisfies the unit ranges and totals
error_codes.single_ion_claim: the logic holds with no evidence unit or with one (two-ion check, pass 1)
error_codes.support_target_is_precursor: a support or upgrade member equals a hypothesis precursor m/z
error_codes.syntax: not RFC 8259 JSON (comments, trailing commas, raw control characters ...)
error_codes.top_level_not_object: the top level is not an object
error_codes.typed_mass: a typed mass; rule files hold formulas only
error_codes.unexpected_file: a *.json outside the layout (or a staging file without --draft)
error_codes.unknown_adduct: an adduct name missing from adducts.json
error_codes.unknown_ion_key: a scaffold ion key missing (or empty for the mode) in some entry
error_codes.unknown_key: a key outside the closed key set
error_codes.unknown_motif: a motif id missing from motifs.json
error_codes.unknown_scaffold_list: a scaffold list that does not exist, or scaffold_ions without a scaffold list
error_codes.unknown_source_ref: a provenance token src:<i> past the end of source
error_codes.unknown_term: a term id that no term defines
error_codes.unknown_unit: a unit name missing from units.json
error_codes.unknown_variable: a k variable outside the closed set
error_codes.unused_term: a non-upgrade term that the logic never uses

loader_errors.call: rule_format.load_files(files, draft=False): every *.json at a layout path is hashed, the motif and nesting tables are required, staging folders are unexpected, and the version pin is checked against ruleset-history.tsv

oracle: CPython json, struct and hashlib through tools/ws8_p3/rule_format.py

sections.file_hashes: file map -> per-file canonical sha256 and ruleset_sha256; every given file is hashed
sections.fixed_decimal: double, decimals -> exact half-even text; all-zero digits carry no sign (design 4.11)
sections.float_lexeme: accepted float lexeme -> IEEE bits; mantissa / 10^scale is the one division of design 3.1
sections.ieee_bits: IEEE pattern -> bits() with every NaN canonicalised (design 4.11)
sections.instrument_class: UTF-16 code units or null -> the ASCII-only instrument class (design 4.9)
sections.loader_errors: base_files updated by each patch (null removes a path) -> the exact sorted error list [code, file, RFC 6901 pointer]; one case per error code
sections.masses: lexeme and formula -> integer pDa; ions and adduct precursors with the electron; refused formulas
sections.result_double: double, decimals -> text, or null when not finite (design 4.11)
sections.ruleset_load: clean synthetic sets -> ruleset, file and rule semantic sha256 with each rule's resolved set
sections.strict_json: input bytes -> ok with canonical text and sha256 of it, or the reader's error code
